newsitem.title: UK: India buys 12,000 tonnes palm olein - trade.
newsitem.headline: India buys 12,000 tonnes palm olein - trade.

text.p: India's State Trading Corporation (STC) bought 12,000 tonnes of palm olein at its tender on Tuesday, European vegetable oil traders said.
Traders said the STC bought 6,000 tonnes for shipment between September 25 and October 10 and a further 6,000 tonnes for first half October shipment.
Traders were unable to give any further details.
"All we know is that the price paid was in the region of $603 a tonne," said one. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
